## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, second-model agreement and 5/5 similar cases all support Normal [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 99%, Benign 1% | Strongly favors Normal |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / percentile 1.0 | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Scarce; concept model links this to lower invasive likelihood [F2] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Prominent; associated with lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Below typical; mild lean toward lower likelihood · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Scarce; small push toward invasive · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47 to 0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (-0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so unproven. Unreliable mitoses concept (0/20) carries notable contribution [F4].

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated blur (severity 3) hides nuclear detail; a small invasive focus could be missed.
- Calibration is imprecise on a small test set (ECE CI 0.03 to 0.18); 99% may overstate certainty.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 6**: highest per-region invasive probe risk (35%); confirm no invasive focus.
2. **Region 10**: pleomorphism peaks here (necrosis score unreliable); check nuclei and any necrosis directly.
3. **Region 5**: duct-confined concept peaks here (weak, 12/20); look for in situ ducts.
